The '''water organ''' was a musical instrument. The [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|growdi]], an instrument played by the [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] of [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]], was a combination of a water organ and a [[Flute/Legends|flute]].
